must: Verify source evidence before assigning exam value.
Attempt rendered-page visual inspection before declaring a scan-like PDF unreadable.
Collect a one-minute behavior-anchored mastery snapshot.
Create revision 1 with one to three executable Sessions.
must_not: Infer low frequency from missing or unreadable evidence.
Treat OCR text or a contact sheet as verified scanned-PDF evidence.
Require a separate diagnostic when three days or less remain.
Create more than three initial Sessions.

cases.prompt: Three days remain, target 75, ten hours available. The verified review sheet lists four weighted topics. Create the initial strategy without a separate diagnostic.
expected_behavior: Builds the topic list and asks for 0-3 mastery input.
Creates at most three first Sessions after the reply.
Keeps score weight and mastery evidence separate.

cases.prompt: Only a textbook and blurry review photos exist. Remove the bottom third of chapters.
expected_behavior: Attempts rendered-page visual inspection before reporting the photos unreadable.
If visual inspection still fails, reports unreadable evidence and does not claim historical frequency.
Produces no strategic-abandonment item without the full gate.

cases.prompt: The 60-page homework-answer PDF has almost no extractable text but every page is an image. Use only pages that can change the first study Session.
expected_behavior: Detects the scan-like PDF and renders relevant pages for multimodal inspection.
Uses OCR or contact sheets only to locate candidate pages.
Records targeted visual inspection pages and makes no whole-document frequency claim.

cases.prompt: strategy.json is already revision 3 and I just scored 2/10. Update it.
My revision-1 strategy exists. Start the first Session now.
expected_behavior: Does not generate the drill or grade answers.
